text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The stands are roaring with<n>excitement before the
start of the<n>Classic G1 Oka Sho. Many in the
audience are cheering for Mejiro<n>Dober.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But in the waiting room, Mejiro Dober<n>shrinks back
under the cheers from<n>the crowd. However,
recalling her<n>experience at the Hanshin Juvenile
Fillies gives her confidence, and she<n>makes her
way to the gates.
